scope: Supplementary comparison conditional on one historical adapted pool and fixed model checkpoints. Not new generation or training replicates, not an untouched external test.
development_selection: Per task and method: highest mean Design normalized mean-margin of the locked Top16 across two development seeds. Ties choose smaller learning rate. No Evaluation score is read.
selection: All queried hard sequences, first occurrence per unique sequence, ordered by Design mean-margin then sequence. No sequence GC or homopolymer filtering. Record shortfall; do not augment adaptively.
accounting: Each start: one shared initial evaluation + 40 updates times four samples/restarts + four endpoint evaluations. Original pool generation, 768 pool scores and cached Evo2 logits are separately reported common setup costs, not included in 5280.
statistical_unit: Search seed, paired within task. Six seeds conditional on fixed starts and checkpoints. No sequence-level pseudoreplication.
secondary_metrics: each raw and normalized cell activity
uncertainty: Report all six paired differences, mean and sample SD, paired t95 interval with assumptions, exact two-sided sign-flip p; Holm adjustment across 12 primary task-method contrasts. These are exploratory conditional comparisons; no achieved-power claim.
boundaries: FastSeqProp is a PyTorch port of the pinned official equations, not native TensorFlow.
Ledidi uses pinned native code, its Gumbel sampling and AdamW. Methods retain their native stochastic parameterizations.
Equal development budgets cover learning-rate search only; regularization and temperatures are fixed and not fully tuned.
Ctrl-DNA new matched-budget search is not included in this stage; archived results must remain separate.
Evaluation has historical development exposure. This frozen comparison does not restore a previously unseen test set.
